## Collection & Soft-Brand Options for Hotel Conversions in Mexico

citations.cited_text: Soft brands are a hybrid between independent and core-branded properties. In general, soft branded hotels enjoy the benefits of the marketing programs...
citations.title: Soft Brands – A Third Alternative | CBRE

content.text: Soft brands are a hybrid between independent and core-branded properties. In general, soft-branded hotels enjoy the benefits of marketing programs and reservation systems of core brands, but have greater flexibility regarding facilities, services, and operating standards. They are frequently the choice of owners of hotels that have a historical reputation and identity of their own.

When an owner in Mexico is exploring collection or soft-brand conversion options, the following brands are most commonly considered:

---

Building on this success, Marriott expanded its offerings through the acquisition of Starwood Hotels and Resorts, adding other soft brands like **The Luxury Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio**, and **Design Hotels**.

content.text: **City Express by Marriott** — which was originally a lodging brand in Mexico before its acquisition by Marriott International — became a lower-end conversion brand for the multinational lodging company.

When combined, these platforms allow operators to tailor service levels to local Mexican expectations while maintaining global consistency.

### Summary Table

| Brand Family | Soft Brand / Collection | Segment |
|---|---|---|
| Marriott | Autograph Collection, Luxury Collection, Tribute Portfolio, Design Hotels, City Express | Midscale–Luxury |
| IHG | Vignette Collection, voco, Garner | Midscale–Luxury |
| Hilton | Curio Collection, Tapestry Collection, Spark | Select–Upscale |
| Hyatt | Unscripted by Hyatt, The Unbound Collection | Upscale |
| Wyndham | Trademark Collection, Registry Collection | Upscale–Luxury |
| Choice Hotels | Ascend Hotel Collection | Midscale–Upscale |
| Accor | MGallery, Emblems Collection, Handwritten Collection | Midscale–Luxury |
| Independent | Preferred Hotels & Resorts, Hamak Hotels | Boutique/Luxury |

The right choice depends on the property's location, segment, size, and the owner's priorities — whether that's maximizing loyalty program exposure, minimizing renovation requirements, or preserving a unique local identity.
